-- Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2e-U1 (addendum V2e, debt D56): a
-- unification hint in a module that is not a listed metaprogramming module.
-- unif_hint is no keyword of addendum V2c.2, and a hint registers no token,
-- parser, macro or elaborator, so the in-tree command accepts the module. The
-- hint is an entry in Lean.Meta.unificationHintExtension, which no audited
-- module writes on the unmodified tree, so the executable refuses it through
-- the extension allowlist.

namespace TrustSelfTestPlant

structure PlantedCarrier where
  carrier : Type

def plantedNatCarrier : PlantedCarrier := ⟨Nat⟩

unif_hint (c : PlantedCarrier) where
  c =?= plantedNatCarrier ⊢ PlantedCarrier.carrier c =?= Nat

end TrustSelfTestPlant
